answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 40086 Country: India Title: I am 29 years of age. My question is that is there any dua in Quran for marriage, as we are searching the girl for past 2 years but did not find the right one Question: I am 29 years of age. My question is that is there any dua in Quran for marriage, as we are searching the girl for past 2 years but did not find the right one. So please guide me. Answer ID: 40086 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1104/685/L=1433) Keep on reciting the following dua extensively: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
